  have eq1 : (3 * p - q) - 9 = 9 - p := by
    have h := h₀ 1
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₃] at h
    linarith
  have eq2 : (3 * p + q) - (3 * p - q) = (3 * p - q) - 9 := by
    have h := h₀ 2
    rw [h₂, h₃, h₄] at h
    linarith
  have hp : p = 5 := by linarith
  have hq : q = 2 := by linarith
  have h_diff_const : ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = 9 - p := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      have h := h₀ 0
      rw [h₁, h₂] at h
      linarith

      have hsucc : a (Nat.succ n + 1) - a (Nat.succ n) = a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) := by
        have h1 : Nat.succ n + 1 = n + 2 := by omega
        have h2 : (Nat.succ n : ℕ) = n + 1 := by omega

  (a : ℕ → ℝ)
  (N : ℕ)
  
  (h₀ : ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n)
  (h₁ : a 1 = p)
  (h₂ : a 2 = 9)
  (h₃ : a 3 = 3 * p - q)
  (h₄ : a 4 = 3 * p + q) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N → (a n = 17 ↔ n = 4) := by
  have he₁ : a 3 - a 2 = a 2 - a 1 := by
    convert h₀ 1 using 1 <;> norm_num
  have he₂ : a 4 - a 3 = a 3 - a 2 := by
    convert h₀ 2 using 1 <;> norm_num
  have hp : p = 5 := by
    linarith [he₁, he₂, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  have ha₁ : a 1 = 5 := by
    linarith [h₁, hp]
  
  have ha : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a n = 4 * (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
        intro hn
        by_cases hn1 : n = 1
        · subst n
          norm_num [ha₁]
        by_cases hn2 : n = 2
        · subst n
          norm_num [h₂]
        have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
        have hnm1 : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
        have hnm2 : 1 ≤ n - 2 := by omega
        have hlt1 : n - 1 < n := by omega
        have hlt2 : n - 2 < n := by omega
        have hi1 := ih (n - 1) hlt1 hnm1
        have hi2 := ih (n - 2) hlt2 hnm2
        have hc1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
          norm_num
        have hc2 : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 2 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
          norm_num
        have hr := h₀ (n - 2)
        have heq1 : n - 2 + 2 = n := by omega
        have heq2 : n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 := by omega
        rw [heq1, heq2] at hr
        rw [hc1] at hi1
        rw [hc2] at hi2
        linarith
  
  intro n hn
  have hpos : 1 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
  constructor
  · intro han
    have hreal : (n : ℝ) = 4 := by
      have hformula := ha n hpos
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  · intro hn4
    subst n
    have hformula := ha 4 (by omega)
    norm_num at hformula
    exact hformula
